metas.name: Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Takes place fifty years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049".

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden death, sheltered teenager Carrie White, raised by her domineering mother, enters public high school, where she faces a viral bullying scandal and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

metas.name: The OA
metas.description: Having gone missing seven years ago, the previously blind Prairie returns home, now in her twenties with her sight restored. While many believe she is a miracle, others worry that she could be dangerous.

metas.name: Russian Doll
metas.description: A cynical young woman in New York City keeps dying and returning to the party that's being thrown in her honor on that same evening. She tries to find a way out of this strange time loop.

metas.name: Tales from the Loop
metas.description: The townspeople who live above "The Loop," a machine built to unlock and explore the mysteries of the universe, experience things previously consigned to the realm of science fiction.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: Series adapted from the award-winning play about a young woman trying to cope with life in London whilst coming to terms with a recent tragedy.

metas.name: Hannibal
metas.description: Explores the early relationship between renowned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter and a young FBI criminal profiler who is haunted by his ability to empathize with serial killers.

metas.name: The Haunting of Hill House
metas.description: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: Chernobyl
metas.description: In April 1986, the city of Chernobyl in the Soviet Union suffers one of the worst nuclear disasters in the history of mankind. Consequently, many heroes put their lives on the line in the following days, weeks and months.

metas.name: Maniac
metas.description: Two strangers are drawn to a mysterious pharmaceutical trial for a drug that they're assured will, with no complications or side-effects whatsoever, permanently solve all of their problems. Things do not go as planned.

metas.name: Devs
metas.description: A computer engineer investigates the secretive development division in her company, which she believes is behind the disappearance of her boyfriend.

metas.name: Black Doves
metas.description: After her lover is murdered by members of London's underworld, a spy - who is publicly the wife of the British Defence Secretary - is protected by an old friend from their agency.

metas.name: Twin Peaks
metas.description: An idiosyncratic FBI agent investigates the murder of a young woman in the even more idiosyncratic town of Twin Peaks.

metas.name: The Fall
metas.description: A Detective Superintendent from England investigates a politically-sensitive murder in Belfast.

metas.name: Dark
metas.description: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the relationships among four families.

metas.name: Legion
metas.description: David Haller is a troubled young man diagnosed with schizophrenia, but after a strange encounter he discovers special powers that will change his life forever.

metas.name: Atlanta
metas.description: Earn and his cousin Alfred try to make their way in the world through Atlanta's rap scene. Along the way they come face-to-face with social and economic issues touching on race, relationships, poverty, status, and parenthood.

metas.name: Reservation Dogs
metas.description: Comedy series about four Native American teenagers growing up on a reservation in eastern Oklahoma.

metas.name: We Are Who We Are
metas.description: Two American kids who live on a U.S. military base in Italy explore friendship, first love, identity, and all the messy exhilaration and anguish of being a teenager.

metas.name: Feel Good
metas.description: The series follows recovering addict and comedian Mae, who is trying to control the addictive behaviors and intense romanticism that permeate every facet of their life.

metas.name: The Curse
metas.description: A newlywed couple struggle to make their vision for eco-living a reality in a small New Mexico town.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

metas.name: Yellowjackets
metas.description: A wildly talented girls' high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.
